title: Migration 0011 data loss: multiple users' mailboxes discarded
description: Migration 0011_drop_user_id_mailboxes.sql discards mailboxes for all users except the one with MIN(user_id). When multiple users exist with provisioned mailboxes, only one user's mailboxes are preserved; all others are lost. This is data loss. Either: (a) preserve all users' mailboxes by adapting the schema to have a stable mailbox_id per role (not per user), (b) fail the migration with an error if multiple users exist, or (c) provide explicit operator migration instructions. Current location: lines 11-13 of migration file.
